OBITUARY REFERENCE 
THE DEPUTY CHAIRMAN: Hon'ble Members, I refer with profound 
sorrow to the passing away of Chaudhary Chunni Lal, a sitting Member of this House, 
on the 3rd December, 2000. 
Born at Allahabad in April, 1933, Chaudhary Chunni Lal had his education 
at University of Allahabad. 
An advocate by profession, Chaudhary Chunni Lal worked for the uplift of 
the downtrodden people through various so cial welfare organisations. He was the 
President of the Uttar Pradesh Rajak Sudha r Sabha and Anusuchit Jaati Morcha. He 
was also Member of the U.P. Public Service Commission from January, 1975 to 
January, 1981.. 
Chaudhary Chunni Lal represented the St ate of Uttar Pradesh in this House 
from November, 1996 till his death. He took keen interest in the proceedings of the 
House. 
in the passing away of Chaudhary Chunni Lal, the country has lost an 
eminent social worker. 
We deeply mourn the passing away of Chaudhary Chunni Lal. 
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a mark of 
respect to the memory of the departed. 
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute) 
THE DEPUTY CHAIRMAN: Secretar y-General will convey to the 
members of the bereaved family our sense of profound sorrow and deep sympathy. 

RAJYA SABHA [4 December, 2000]  
As a mark of respect to the memory  of Chaudhary Chunni Lal, a sitting 
Member, the House is adjourned till 11.00 a.m. on Tuesday, the 5th December, 2000. 
The House then adjourned at three minutes past eleven  of the clock, till eleven of 
the clock on Tuesday, the 5th December, 2000.
